# Menu setting getter

Returns a setting's value by setting id; already called during boot.

**Category:** hook site · **Address:** `0x602e6a02` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700](../firmware/em5-iii-1700.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md)

In section 2. A hook here that serves new ids must not reach a section that is not ready yet; the setter is at 0x602e6f11.

## Observations

- **Physical camera** ([Olympus firmware notes (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)): Hooked for ids 16000-16002 behind a ready-bit guard; boots and serves the new rows. Source: [Saved mod settings and native menu rows on the E-M5 III](../sources/em5n.saved-settings.md).
